note: v1913: Three of his reports in one sitting and the first two are one cause: the forge undo bar bucketed names as in-ITEMS-or-in-UNI-EXTRA with else-to-SET as a catch-all, so Blood Crescent, an off-grail unique in neither list, was claimed by F-Sets and every sets-side undo on it was a no-op. The answer was already two lines below in the same function, where the colour is resolved with the app one classifier - which is why the chip rendered in unique gold while the bucket called it a set. It routes on the classifier now and the catch-all is gone. Third, the in-game found date was built in v1864 and joined to one surface of three, so both FOUND lists printed only the ledger stamp - one shared helper now serves the undo bar and both lists. And stash_screen_open returned a legible-label count as a selected tab, wrong on all three of his frames that took that branch; it asks the gem first now.
